speaker: Narrator
text: The guild office is dark except for a single candle on Tomas's desk.

speaker: Vera
text: While Tomas turns to the window, Vera slides the guild ledger off the desk and tucks it under her cloak.

speaker: Tomas
text: "Have you seen the ledger? I left it right here," Tomas says, patting the empty desk.

speaker: Vera
text: "No idea," Vera says with a shrug. "Maybe the clerk filed it." She keeps her cloak pulled tight.

speaker: Narrator
text: Tomas frowns and starts opening drawers, never looking at Vera's cloak.
